'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Joe Pinto LS Local Uprising (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Pinto]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V)|VB2-L-localuprising-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' annoying Deck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
